knowledge_items.title: Dixon-Coles Model Performance - Premier League August 2026
knowledge_items.content:
Dixon-Coles model performance for Premier League August 2026:
- Accuracy: 64.2%
- CLV correlation: 0.78
- Sample size: 124 matches
- Period: 2026-08-01 to 2026-08-31

knowledge_items.title: Current CLV Gate Configuration
knowledge_items.content: As of 2026-09-06, CLV gate requires >=30 legs with CLV AND mean CLV > 0. Current status: 12/30 legs, mean CLV -1.631% (gate NOT met)

knowledge_items.title: Daily Pipeline Execution
knowledge_items.content: The daily pipeline runs at 22:00 UTC via Task Scheduler, executing run_daily.py which orchestrates SCAN -> trigger -> publish + CLV loop

knowledge_items.title: Architect Signoff for Live Publishing
knowledge_items.content: ARCHITECT_SIGNOFF=1 allows publishing despite CLV gate not being met, used for side-by-side testing

knowledge_items.title: CLV Gate Requirements
knowledge_items.content: The CLV gate requires >=30 legs with CLV AND mean CLV > 0 for publishing to clients
